Registered Nurse salary in California

Based on 9 current job listings that show pay on Fortune Jobs AI (updated November 26, 2026), listed pay for Registered Nurse jobs in California is about $145,143 a year. The median listed midpoint is about $145,143 a year. These figures describe listed pay in current postings, not a salary survey. Hourly and yearly figures are not mixed or extrapolated.

Frequently asked questions

What is typical listed pay?

The median listed salary midpoint is about $145,143 a year across 9 current postings. Most listed midpoints are close together.

Which employers list the highest pay?

Veterans Health Administration: about $145,143 a year (median of 9 listings). Only employers with at least two usable listings of the same pay unit are compared.

Is this a salary survey?

No. The figures are listed pay in current job postings on Fortune Jobs AI, not a salary survey or a prediction of an offer. Listings without usable pay are excluded.
